description: This file defines React components and classes for rendering and managing interactive table elements within a rich text editor, including table component rendering, node view integration, and toolbar controls for rows and columns.

classes.name: TableNode
classes.description: ReactNodeView class for rendering and updating table nodes within the editor, managing DOM structure and update logic.

methods.name: TableComponent
methods.description: React component rendering a table with optional row and column toolbars, handling resize updates.

methods.name: TableNodeView
methods.description: Factory function creating a ReactNodeView for table nodes, with update logic based on node attributes and children.

methods.name: TableRowToolbar
methods.description: React component providing toolbar controls for table rows, positioning based on selection.

methods.name: TableColumnToolbar
methods.description: React component providing toolbar controls for table columns, positioning based on selection.
